description: Primary database for sensor logging, irrigation events, controller health, and internal system tracking.

tables.description: Live time-series readings from all field sensors, including soil moisture, temperature, and rain gauges.

columns.station_id: ID of the station where the sensor is located.
columns.controller_id: Unique identifier of the microcontroller that reported the reading.
columns.sensor_id: Logical sensor name or alias used for querying and grouping (e.g., 'StationExt-SHT-1'). Often used with LIKE queries to retrieve sensor subsets.
columns.sensor_type: Sensor category such as temperature, humidity, water-flow, valve-state, light-intensity, etc.
columns.source_id: Globally unique identifier for the physical sensor source, constructed from system metadata (e.g., 'excessus-home_garden-hydrant_uno-r4-wifi-primary_temperature_StationExt-SHT-1'). Useful for precise identification and internal traceability.
columns.pin: Hardware pin on the controller used for input/output (if applicable).
columns.unit: Unit of the sensor reading, e.g., %, °C, L/min, %RH, PSI, or lux.
columns.received_at: Timestamp when the data was received. ex: 2025-07-09 04:07:31-04

example_prompts: Show the latest soil moisture value.
What was the last rainfall amount?
Get all temperature readings from the past 6 hours.
What value did the controller see for moisture yesterday?
What is the latest reading from StationExt-SHT-1?
Show recent temperature values from SHT sensors.
Get the last water pressure measurement for BeetsTomatoes-Foush.
example_sql_queries: SELECT sensor_id, value, unit FROM sensor_data WHERE sensor_type = 'temperature' AND sensor_id LIKE '%SHT%' ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 3;
SELECT value FROM sensor_data WHERE unit = 'C' AND sensor_id = 'StationExt-SHT-1' ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT * FROM sensor_data WHERE source_id = 'excessus-home_garden-hydrant_uno-r4-wifi-primary_temperature_StationExt-SHT-1' ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 1;

tables.description: Event log of control decisions including manual and automated irrigation commands.

columns.station: The station where the control event was issued.
columns.sensor_id: Sensor used to trigger the action.
columns.command: Type of action taken (e.g., open_valve, start_irrigation).
columns.value: Optional numeric value associated with command.
columns.duration: How long the action lasted (in seconds).

example_prompts: When was the last watering in zone 2?
What command was issued for the tomatoes yesterday?
Show the last time any valve opened.
How long was the sprinkler on?
